title: Verify conversion events live in GA4 DebugView
description:
As Ryan, I want the new events verified against the live site so that I know the numbers are trustworthy before relying on them.

Steps (with Ryan watching): open anth.us with ?debug_mode=1 (or Tag Assistant) and GA4 Admin > DebugView. Click a cta_click CTA in each location: header, footer, hero, band, article, solution-card. Then submit one labelled test lead through /engage/.

Note: the test lead creates a CRM contact in Prospectus; archive it afterwards.

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: CTA clicks
  Given DebugView is open for the live site
  When a CTA is clicked in each of header, footer, hero, band, article and solution-card
  Then one cta_click appears per click with the matching cta_location, cta_text and a path-only link_url
Scenario: Lead event
  Given a labelled test lead is submitted from an /engage/ link carrying from and cta
  When the engage form receives a 202 receipt
  Then exactly one generate_lead appears with form_id, lead_source '<from>#<cta>' and no personal data
Scenario: Cleanup
  Given the test lead created a CRM contact
  When verification finishes
  Then the test contact is archived

Dependencies: none (can run before the key event and dimensions issues).
